title: Warehouse Executive
description:
Roles and Responsibilities 
 Manage warehouse operations, including dispatch, e way bill generation, stock management, and inventory control.
 Ensure accurate tracking of incoming and outgoing goods through inward and outward clearing processes.
 Coordinate with logistics team to ensure timely delivery of products to customers.
 Maintain organized storage facilities by implementing effective shelving systems and labeling procedures.
